name: Galactic Astral
description: A celestial Attack-type Beyblade with four distinct cosmic quadrants and a glowing purple rift core that triggers supernova glass-cannon phase shifts.

ability.name: Nebula Resonance
ability.description: Because of the four distinct cosmic quadrants on its chassis, every successful physical Attack has a 25% chance to trigger a secondary stardust shockwave. This deals bonus damage equal to 30% of Attack and heals 120 HP, but consumes a small amount of extra Stamina.

abilities.name: Nebula Resonance
abilities.description: Because of the four distinct cosmic quadrants on its chassis, every successful physical Attack has a 25% chance to trigger a secondary stardust shockwave. This deals bonus damage equal to 30% of Attack and heals 120 HP, but consumes a small amount of extra Stamina.

abilities.name: Event Horizon
abilities.description: The glowing purple rift in the center acts as a collapsing star. When HP drops below 30%, the Bey routes all its remaining gravitational energy to the perimeter blades. Its Defense drops to 0, but the 88 stat points are immediately transferred to Attack for a supernova-level glass-cannon phase.

abilities.name: Galactic Rift Slash
abilities.description: Channels the chaotic cosmic energy from all four quadrants into the jagged, star-shaped contact points for a devastating high-speed meteor barrage. The final hit tears through the opponent's center of gravity, applying a 'Shatter' debuff that permanently lowers their Defense by 20% for the remainder of the battle.

flavour_texts: 🌌 **Galactic Rift Slash** — all four cosmic quadrants channel chaotic energy into the contact points!
